review_policy: Preserve the published 1,000-rank inventory and order.
Do not change a valid Arabic source spelling merely because a coarse POS tag is surprising.
Use the paper's vocalized form/POS, CALIMA-MSA morphology, independent corpus attestation, and external dictionary evidence together.
Treat missing external gloss overlap as a review signal rather than proof of an error.
Resolve source/OCR defects conservatively and keep true unvocalized homographs when they are genuinely represented by the ranked form.
Keep hard-coded regression tripwires for high-risk spellings and meanings.
